extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism adjudication from current XML/PDF/OA figures. Mechanism is constrained to membrane binding/fluidity context and viral-entry interference phenotype; no unsupported universal AMP mechanism is promoted.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Fragments B and D bind the T. brucei surface, while killing by active fragments D/P is temperature dependent; this supports parasite surface/membrane involvement but not a single resolved intracellular target.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: defensin fragments B, D, and P in T. brucei assays
direct_assay_types: fluorescence microscopy binding with biotinylated fragments

source_locator.locator: xml:sec=15:Membrane Binding; xml:sec=14:Temperature Effect; xml:fig=5:Figure 5; xml:fig=4:Figure 4

mechanism_claims.limitations: Binding alone did not explain killing because fragment B bound similarly but was minimally active; mechanism remains membrane-context rather than precise target identification.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Fragments P and Q reduced HIV-1 infection only when virus was exposed to peptide before cell infection; cell pretreatment followed by washing did not inhibit infection.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: defensin fragments P and Q in MAGIC-5B HIV-1 infection assay

mechanism_claims.limitations: Assay supports early virus-peptide interference context, not a mapped viral protein target or intracellular antiviral mechanism.
